common.name: Name
settings.languageHint: Translates the app's own text. Game rules stay in English.
player.title: Player view
nav.jumpTo: Jump to a page, or search your campaign…
settings.importHint: Bring in a markdown vault or a filled-in character sheet PDF.
player.reconnecting: Lost contact with the table — showing the last update.
encounter.thresholdsHint: Thresholds are the party's total XP budget for each difficulty. The fight's adjusted XP (monster XP × the group multiplier) is compared against them.
encounter.addOneHint: The fight's difficulty if you add one more of these
encounter.fitsHint: On its own this creature is a Medium or Hard fight for the selected party
encounter.liveHint: Rated from the player characters and bestiary creatures in this fight. Quick-added creatures have no XP and aren't counted.
combat.lairHint: Initiative 20, losing ties — the lair acts once this round.
combat.hasLairHint: Adds a "Lair Actions" row at initiative 20 every round.
combat.legendaryHint: Click a pip to spend a legendary action at the end of another creature's turn. They refresh at the start of this creature's turn.
combat.legendaryPerRoundHint: 0 for none. Most legendary creatures have 3.
combat.reactionHint: Click when the reaction is used. It comes back at the start of this creature's turn.
combat.ungroup: Ungroup — give each member its own turn
combat.addAsGroupHint: One initiative row and one turn for the whole pack. Expand it to track each member's HP.
builder.groupMonstersHint: Several of the same creature share one initiative row and one turn.
conditions.startOfTurn: at the start of its turn
conditions.endOfTurn: at the end of its turn
conditions.durationHint: Rounds count this creature's own turns, and the condition drops off by itself when they run out. Leave rounds blank for a condition you'll remove by hand.
resources.title: Limited-use abilities
resources.empty: Track things like Second Wind, Channel Divinity or Rage. Short and long rests restore them by their recharge.
resources.short: Recharges on a short or long rest
portrait.upload: Upload a portrait (also used as the battle-map token)
aoe.title: Apply area damage
aoe.noTargets: No combatant tokens on this map yet. Add combatants from the linked encounter to damage them here.
aoe.failed: Couldn't apply the damage to everyone — check the tracker
player.dragHint: Drag your token to move it.
clocks.title: Clocks
clocks.empty: Track looming threats and long projects as segmented clocks — "The ritual completes", "The guard grows suspicious".
clocks.shown: Shown to players — click to hide
clocks.hidden: Hidden from players — click to show
whatsNew.title: What's new in Sanctum {version}
randomEnc.title: Random encounters
randomEnc.none: No random-encounter table here yet. Link one of your roll tables (Shops & Loot → Roll Tables), then roll it from this page.
randomEnc.empty: That table has no entries yet
randomEnc.noCreatures: No creatures from your bestiary are named in this result.
popout.hint: Open in its own window, e.g. on a second monitor
popout.soundHandoff: Playback moved to the pop-out window
shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.hint: Shortcuts never fire while you're typing in a field or have a button focused, and they're also listed in the rules reference.
bulk.confirmBody: You can undo this from the notification for a few minutes.
log.export: Save the combat log as a file
support.hint: Sanctum is free and has no ads — a tip on Ko-fi helps keep it going
